title: Design System: rayyanabzal.com

ink-muted.note: Raised to clear 4.5:1 on stone and paper. Never on a coloured surface.

display.purpose: Home hero headline only, max 13ch, balanced wrap.

display-case.purpose: Case-study title, max 12ch, one word in pine-bright.

headline.purpose: Section headings on every page and the CTA panel heading.

headline-block.purpose: Case-study block heading, left column of a case block.

title.purpose: Card, offer, and prose subheads. Steps 20px, case nav targets 21px.

lede.purpose: Paragraph under a display or headline, ink-soft, max 58ch.

body.purpose: Base size on body. About prose runs clamp(17px, 1.35vw, 19px) at 1.6.

body-small.purpose: Card and offer copy, button text.

value.purpose: Bold opening line of a side card; case meta cells use 600 at 16.5px. The chrome's only label form.

note.purpose: Data disclosure, stat labels, footer, case nav labels. Always ink-muted on stone or paper.

data.purpose: Synthetic product data inside .card-visual (12px, 1.3) and .case-preview (13px, 1.6). Never UI chrome.

fontLoading.method: preload as=style with onload swap to stylesheet, noscript fallback
fontLoading.future: self-hosting is a noted improvement, not current state

shadows.name: button-rest
shadows.purpose: Hairline under a pine pill at rest. The only resting shadow on chrome.

shadows.name: nav-card-lift
shadows.purpose: Case prev/next card hover, with translateY(-3px).

shadows.name: device-frame
shadows.purpose: Paper device inside a card schematic, at rest. Inside the drawn product, not on chrome.

shadows.name: floating-cta
shadows.purpose: Sticky mobile pill separating from scrolling content.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Ink toast inside a schematic on card hover.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Site ease for every transition and reveal (--ease).

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One fade-up per .reveal; .in starts it, .done replaces it after 1400ms.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: data-stagger on card grids and steps.

motion.name: hero-sequence
motion.value: h1 0.9s at 0.05s, lede 0.8s at 0.25s, actions 0.8s at 0.4s
motion.purpose: Hero panel children stagger via CSS delays, not data-stagger.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Card lift with the schematic device rising 6px.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.purpose: Gold underline on hover and aria-current.

motion.name: pulse-soft
motion.purpose: Live dot inside a schematic. The only looping animation.

motion.name: failsafe
motion.purpose: Nothing stays hidden if IntersectionObserver fails. Reduced-motion and no-JS get the static page.

breakpoints.name: schematic-density
breakpoints.purpose: Card schematic drops a column and goes 4:3.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Nav links hidden, mobile pill row and sticky CTA appear, case nav stacks, preview tightens.

breakpoints.name: case-meta
breakpoints.purpose: Case meta strip to two columns.

breakpoints.name: case-block
breakpoints.purpose: Case block heading and prose stack.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Two- and three-column grids, about split, and CTA panel go single column; steps go two columns.

narrative.northStar: A Quiet Room with One Loud Sentence
narrative.overview:
The site is a single-person AI engineering practice in Auckland, and the visual system is built so that one headline does the talking and everything else stays out of its way. The page ground is warm stone, every content block is a large rounded paper surface set on that ground, and the only colour that ever raises its voice is a kowhai gold marker drawn behind a few words. Buttons are pine-dark pills. Type is one family, Bricolage Grotesque, set tight and heavy for headlines and plain for everything else. There are few elements per view, and each view is meant to be read in one glance before the eye moves down.

This world deliberately refuses the "terminal dashboard" arrangement the old site used: no monospace labels in the chrome, no grid texture, no status pills, no at-a-glance tables. Where product needs to be shown, it is drawn as a CSS schematic with representative data, disclosed on the page as such, never as a client screenshot. The one dark surface on the whole site is the case-study preview panel, and it exists only to hold that synthetic product data.

The structure follows the calm, image-led rhythm of the pinned reference (bencium.io) in Rayyan's own materials. The hero panel is the memorable moment: one giant tight headline on a soft sage field with a single pine pill, then the four project schematics peeking under the fold.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone ground with paper surfaces at 24px radius; the hero panel is the only sage field
Pine pill buttons everywhere, gold pill only on a pine field
Gold appears as a marker highlight behind words, a link underline, and a soft radial glow; never as a fill for a surface
One typeface at four weights; display type at -0.04em, body at 17px
Flat at rest, lift on hover; shadows exist only as a response to interaction
Monospace lives only inside drawn product schematics and the case preview panel
No eyebrows, kickers, or uppercase tracked labels in the UI chrome

rules.name: The One Loud Colour Rule
rules.body: Gold is a marker, an underline, and a glow. It is never the background of a card, panel, or section. The only gold-filled shape is a pill button, and that pill exists only on a pine field.

rules.name: The Pine Pill Rule
rules.body: Every pill button is pine (.btn). On a pine field (the CTA panel, the case CTA) the pill switches to gold (.btn-gold) for contrast. .btn-light (paper with a hairline border) is the secondary choice beside a pine pill, used on the 404 page.

rules.name: The One Sage Field Rule
rules.body: The hero panel is the only sage surface. Sections sit directly on the stone ground; there is no full-bleed tint band.

rules.name: The Coloured Surface Rule
rules.body: On pine or ink, text is paper or paper at reduced opacity (78%, 75%, 70%). Grey text (ink-muted, ink-soft) never sits on a coloured surface.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, kicker, overline, or uppercase tracked label above any heading in the UI chrome. A section opens on its headline. A side card or meta cell opens on a bold value line. The only uppercase tracked text on the site is column headers inside a drawn schematic or the case preview, where it is product data.

rules.name: The Data Face Rule
rules.body: Monospace is allowed only inside .card-visual schematics and .case-preview. It is synthetic product data, never UI chrome. No monospace in copy, nav, buttons, labels, or footers.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: A headline or quote carries at most one gold-marked phrase, and most carry none.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Chrome surfaces cast no shadow at rest. A shadow is a hover response, paired with a translate, and it is removed entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses a large blur and a negative spread at least half the blur, tinted with ink or pine, never black. No hard offset shadows anywhere.

dos: Do set every content surface as paper on the stone ground at 24px radius, with no border and no resting shadow.
Do make every pill button pine; switch to the gold pill only when the button sits on a pine field.
Do use gold as a marker behind at most one phrase per headline or quote, as the 2px link underline, and as the corner glow on the hero and CTA panels.
Do open a side card or meta cell on a bold value line (700 at 17px, or 600 at 16.5px) followed by one plain sentence.
Do keep the hero-to-first-cards gap tight (12px plus 12px) so the project cards peek under a 900px fold.
Do use ink-muted (5f5a52) for the quietest text, and only on stone or paper.
Do show product as a drawn schematic with representative data inside .card-visual or .case-preview, and disclose it in a visible .data-note.
Do attribute testimonials by role and project until clients approve names.
Do add hover lift as a translate plus a soft ink- or pine-tinted shadow, and remove both under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do mark the current nav item with aria-current="page" so the gold underline and the ink mobile pill follow.
donts: Don't add an eyebrow, kicker, overline, or uppercase tracked label above a heading anywhere in the chrome.
Don't use monospace outside .card-visual and .case-preview, and never for UI labels, nav, buttons, or copy.
Don't place a second sage field or a full-bleed tint band; the hero panel is the only sage surface.
Don't fill a card, panel, or section with gold; gold is a marker, an underline, a glow, and one pill on pine.
Don't put grey text (ink-soft, ink-muted) on pine or ink; use paper at reduced opacity.
Don't use client screenshots, a stock photo, or a placeholder portrait; the world runs without imagery.
Don't add hard offset shadows, borders on cards, or a second dark surface beyond the case preview.
Don't add sweep, scan-line, or looping decorative motion on panels; the only looping animation is the pulsing live dot inside a schematic.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a system display face; Bricolage Grotesque at 400 to 700 is the whole ramp.

notCanonized: Hidden kicker remnants in case markup (.case-kicker, .case-block-head with numbered .key spans, data-step counters, .case-title .dot) are display:none carry-overs from the previous world, not a rule. Future surfaces should not add them.
--r-sm (14px) is declared but never referenced; .eyebrow-free is a dead class; --warn is used once (.vis-warn). None are recorded as scale steps.
The case preview's #a8d5b5 and #e8b878 status colours are hardcoded, not tokens; they belong to that one dark surface and are carried in its component snippet only.
404.html styles its display size and margins inline; those are one-offs, not a ramp step.
